summary: I agree with the engine and with stage 1. The veterans benefits are exempt from tax, so West Virginia AGI is the spouse's $88,928 of wages. Subtracting two $2,000 personal exemptions leaves $84,928 of taxable income. Enrolled SB 392 adds W. Va. Code §11-21-4j, which applies to taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2026; it passed March 14, 2026, before the freeze. Under it, the tax is $1,950.50 + 4.58% × $24,928 ≈ $3,092.20. No nonrefundable credits apply. The engine reached $3,092.19 by the same steps; it carried AGI as $88,927.65, a $0.35 float artifact worth about one cent of tax. The models' $3,255.03 used the 2025 §11-21-4i rates (2.22% to 4.82%), which SB 392 replaced for 2026.
